data.spiritual_meaning: Bradley expresses “Blessed by God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bradley total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
